os-21-20.alt: Two panels. Top: a dendritic cell with many long branching arms; a close-up shows one arm holding an antigen in an MHC II protein, bound by a T cell receptor and a CD4 protein on an activated helper T cell. An arrow leads to the helper T cell releasing a cloud of dots labeled cytokines. Bottom: an infected cell holds antigens in an MHC I protein, bound by a T cell receptor and a CD8 protein on an activated cytotoxic T cell. An arrow leads to the infected cell broken into fragments, with dots labeled perforins and granzymes scattered around it.
